releaseBlockingFindings.remediation: Atomic bounded Redis buckets and coarse trusted ingress policy

releaseBlockingFindings.finding: Spring does not consume arbitrary DATASOURCE_PASSWORD_FILE variables
releaseBlockingFindings.remediation: Mandatory file-mounted configtree and reject raw password environment values in release guard

releaseBlockingFindings.finding: Alert rules reference nonexistent metrics and unevaluated dotenv receiver URL
releaseBlockingFindings.remediation: Real metrics, promtool trigger fixtures and explicit secret-file receiver renderer

releaseBlockingFindings.finding: Production resource servers did not consistently require the public API audience; metrics permissions differed between services
releaseBlockingFindings.remediation: Mandatory production audiences and verified metrics.read/admin authorization; separate scoped metrics token projection

releaseBlockingFindings.finding: Shared Redis credentials allowed unrelated workloads to inherit administration access; restricted Redis 7 quota transactions did not retain spent buckets after AOF restart
releaseBlockingFindings.remediation: Separate quota, replication, notification and monitoring credentials/ACLs; pin the dedicated quota store to the verified Redis 8.6 image

releaseBlockingFindings.finding: Management services shared database network access and alert delivery lacked external receiver egress
releaseBlockingFindings.remediation: Separate private ops network, no ingress attachment to data, explicit bounded Alertmanager receiver egress and managed configuration group permissions

releaseBlockingFindings.finding: Telemetry exceptions could retain upstream messages or omit classified asynchronous failures from error sampling
releaseBlockingFindings.remediation: Redact status/event exception content, retain bounded protocol status codes and mark classified outbox/webhook failures without copying exception messages

Filter customer webhook interests by the canonical event customer, and recheck persisted payload ownership before queued delivery; missing owner information fails closed. Administrator event streams retain their reviewed global scope.
